meta.title: Uni Constellation — Law × Economics public-data pilot
notes: Thematic similarity is TF-IDF keyword overlap on titles (+ abstracts/keywords when edoc provides them); it is a suggestion, not a collaboration.
Coauthorship means both names appear on the same publication record in this snapshot.
Map positions are a force layout for readability, not calibrated distances.

author-of.evidenceBasis: researcher appears in the publication's author list (edoc list when matched, else parsed citation)

coauthorship.evidenceBasis: both appear in the author list of every publication in evidencePublicationIds

thematic-similarity.evidenceBasis: TF-IDF cosine of titles, plus edoc abstracts and keywords where available; sharedTerms lists the strongest common terms
